topic: Command log keeps terms split by shell quoting
detail: Low, INV-07 (SP-044 review round 2): the command log redacts the tool input's decoded JSON text, not the words as the shell passes them, so gh issue create -b fal''con is stored as written. The check itself reads the shell words. Proposed: redact, or withhold the command, when a shell-decoded word holds a term.
